# Task Template

## Objective

What user or operational outcome are we trying to achieve?

## Non-goals

What is explicitly out of scope for this task?

## Scope

- Areas of the app or docs affected
- External systems or env vars involved

## Acceptance Criteria

- User-visible outcome
- Operational outcome
- Error-state handling

## Verification

- Commands to run
- Manual flows to test
- Devices or breakpoints to check

## Risks and Assumptions

- Missing infrastructure
- Temporary compromises
- Follow-up dependencies
